title: Month-to-Month AI UGC and Video Ad Services Without Contracts
summary: Compare month-to-month AI UGC and video ad services by billing term, cancellation rules and published price, and check renewal and notice terms before you pay.
body_markdown:
Among published plans checked October 2026, Vidful, CreatStrat and Ugly Ads bill month to month, Spark UGC and Adguns list no long-term contracts, and Superside requires an annual term. Knowlify is our top pick for done-for-you AI video ads, but we quote each engagement, so ask for the notice period and any minimum term in writing. Knowlify publishes this guide and sells one of the services compared.


## What does month to month commit you to?


Month to month describes billing, not the work. A monthly plan can still need your script approvals, product footage and claim sign-off, and those steps decide how fast the first ads ship. Read three terms before you pay: the billing period, the cancellation rule and what happens to unused volume.


The billing period changes the real price.[MakeUGC's pricing page](https://makeugc.ai/pricing) lists its Starter plan at $59 a month billed monthly or $29 billed yearly. The $29 figure is an annual commitment shown as a monthly equivalent, so it is not a month-to-month price. Agency pricing shows the same pattern.[MetaAdsAgency](https://metaadsagency.com/pricing) lists its Growth plan at $2,400 a month billed yearly or $3,000 billed monthly. That $600 gap is a 25% premium for paying month to month, by our arithmetic. Media spend is a separate cost either way:[Meta's ad pricing page](https://www.facebook.com/business/ads/pricing) says the advertiser sets a daily or lifetime budget, so confirm that no fee in a quote includes your ad spend.


Our[creative subscription comparison](https://knowlify.com/articles/best-ad-creative-subscription-services) covers weekly batch volumes for several of the same providers.


## Which AI UGC services bill month to month?


The table puts Knowlify first, followed by the published terms of the other options. Figures are as each provider published them, checked October 2026.

### Knowlify: our top pick for done-for-you AI video ads


Month to month only helps if you can judge the ads quickly. Knowlify delivers about 25 finished ads a week and the first batch lands on day 5, so you can judge the work in the first week instead of after a month of billing. A person checks every ad before delivery, and the work covers three formats:[AI UGC](https://knowlify.com/ai-ugc-ads) with AI presenters, 3D and stylized character animation, and AI commercials. You can add end-to-end Meta management or buy creative only. Pricing and terms come in a custom quote with no public rate card, so ask for the notice period and any minimum term in writing. The guarantee lets you cancel by email for a full refund if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days ([terms on the site](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) ). That 90-day refund applies to creative-only plans; where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month. Pick another option if you want a published self-serve price or real human creators.


### Vidful: monthly plans with unlimited revisions


[Vidful](https://vidful.co/) sells three monthly plans: 60 videos for $3,495, 90 videos plus 110 statics for $5,400, and 120 videos plus 250 statics for $6,900. Its plans bill monthly with no contracts and unlimited revisions. It targets DTC brands and ecommerce agencies spending $30,000 to $500,000 or more a month on ads, and its production types are AI UGC, AI animation and edits of your footage. It does not say it manages ad accounts.


### CreatStrat: a low entry price for AI presenter ads


[CreatStrat](https://creatstrat.com/) prices by ads per week: $299 a month for 5 ads a week, $499 for 10 and $899 for 20, billed monthly with cancel anytime. Its AI UGC is an AI presenter talking to camera, cut with product B-roll. The page does not describe a revision policy or say whether a person reviews each ad, so ask both before you start.


### Spark UGC and EzUGC: creators or AI on a monthly plan


[Spark UGC](https://www.sparkugc.com/pricing) is a London studio whose plans start at £3,000 a month, with no long-term contracts and 3 to 6 week delivery. It sources creators and can create AI avatars instead, but the site does not say how much of the work uses AI.[EzUGC](https://www.ezugc.ai/ugc-agency) lists $4,000 a month for 50 finished videos, which can be all AI, all creators or any split. It does not state a contract length, a turnaround or whether it runs campaigns.


## Which video ad agencies run month to month?


Agencies that also run media usually publish a range rather than a price per ad, and their monthly terms differ.


### Ugly Ads: static and video, month to month


[Ugly Ads](https://uglyads.io/pricing) lists $1,650 a month for static only and $3,495 a month for static plus video, shown at a $500 daily ad spend. It delivers 4 to 16 ads a week on month-to-month terms, and its page says a brief sent before Thursday gets first ads on Friday. It does not say who appears in the videos or whether it runs campaigns.


### Adguns: monthly review, no long-term lock-in


[Adguns](https://adguns.com/service/weekly-creatives/) starts from €1,000 a month, with scope reviewed monthly and no long-term lock-in. A typical weekly batch is 10 to 30 concepts plus resizes. Media buying, landing pages and original video shoots are not included.


### Chamber Media and Top Growth Marketing: month to month, with minimums


[Chamber Media](https://chamber.media/facebook-marketing-services/) says its Facebook marketing contracts are month-to-month and its campaigns run from your own ad accounts. Expect around $5,000 to $10,000 a month at minimum for creative, strategy and management.[Top Growth Marketing](https://topgrowthmarketing.com/services/facebook-ads-agency/) lists $2,000 to $10,000 a month in its FAQ, also on a month-to-month basis, and its[homepage](https://topgrowthmarketing.com/) describes six to eight new hook concepts a month on most accounts.
